styleSelection.reason: Loose ink-and-wash landscape on cold-press paper: a selective, continuous sepia structural drawing of the winding sandy path, hillside crests, and outer meadow-to-treeline silhouettes precedes luminous hansa/sap-green/ochre ground washes, layered olive-and-slate foliage masses, and crisp closing sepia contour accents.

sandy_winding_path.notes: Warm cream-ochre and pale hansa/sienna wash along the S-curving sandy track (`litL=85`, `litReserveL=96`, `_lit45_lw`), preserving true center-of-track sunlit paper glints while grading road shoulders into the bordering grass.

sunlit_meadow_slopes.notes: Broad luminous hansa yellow, sap green, and yellow ochre washes across the lower-right foreground meadow, central ridge, and upper slopes, laid in cohesive directional strokes before darker foliage overlays.

midtone_olive_foliage.notes: Two-pass textured midtone washes (`_lay2_lt_nest`) in sap green, yellow ochre, and burnt sienna establishing the scalloped oak and scrub-covered hillsides without flat gray-blue sky-lane slabs.

deep_canopy_shadows.notes: Rich ultramarine + sap green + burnt sienna + sepia shadow glazes (`_dk125`, `_st36`, `_rec2x_rcl`) tucked into the cool slate-olive tree cores, valley clefts, and under-canopy cast shadows.

closing_sepia_contours.notes: Selective dry-brush sepia contour ink (`_ink4`, `_sep5`, `_dwg115`) reinforcing the winding road shoulders, wheel ruts, hillside ridges, trunks, and major canopy divisions.
